name: Hanegasaki Mariko
source:
"I'm sure we're going to be happy.
Father and Mother, and now Yoshino, too, are watching over us from heaven.
We have to move on with our lives and be happy."

The eldest daughter of the long-standing, noble Hanegasaki family.
She is a dignified lady who charms people with her elegant looks and her open-minded and refined demeanor.
She and her twin sister, Miyako, have been together with their childhood friend Yoshino since
they were born.
She loves to dote on her younger twin sister.

[From [url=https://lilja-natsuka.frontwing.co.jp/en/]Official Website[/url]]
